column4: dialect-gated per SUBTEST (cleat#3630): the test runs one subtest per dialect that supports workflow libraries (PostgreSQL and SQL Server; MySQL has no library schema by decision D41), each through a rig that skips when its DSN is unset. This job configures PostgreSQL only, so the sqlserver subtest skips ONCE while postgres RUNS. Measured 2026-10-31 with only PostgreSQL configured.
